query: Please implement a Telegram-based game website for initiating red packet games. The website should have functionalities for receiving Telegram bot messages, initiating games, determining if a user has hit a "mine", and settling the game. Users can participate in the game by sending messages through Telegram, and the website will determine if a user has hit a "mine" based on the red packets they have obtained, and then settle the game accordingly. Define the background as light beige and components as sienna.
